blockingFindings.title: Missing target normalization coverage for findingId
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding test coverage for its normalization behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: R1 requires findingId to be derived from a normalized target, but the tests only use already-normalized targets like "R3" and "R4". A parser that hashes raw target text would still pass these tests while violating the requirement.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local identity test that parses equivalent non-normalized target representations and asserts they produce the same findingId as the normalized target.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding test coverage for its normalization behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Flow exhaustion is not tested with residual currentTaskId
blockingFindings.rationale: A core acceptance condition for flow-level review scope can pass without exercising the residual task cursor case named by the requirement.
blockingFindings.issue: R5 specifically requires flow-level canonical exhaustion to save taskId:null completion and flow finding handoff even when currentTaskId is non-null, but the exhaustion evidence test uses state = { reviewConvergence: { version: 1, records: [] } } with no currentTaskId.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Set currentTaskId to a non-null value in the exhausted flow evidence test and assert the saved record remains taskId:null with one handoff per identity.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A core acceptance condition for flow-level review scope can pass without exercising the residual task cursor case named by the requirement.
